subject: SIDE PATCH for root (translator re-pin) + offset-template CANDIDATE validated in a private tree; will land in the shared tree after 'C6p committed'
body:
TRANSLATOR SIDE PATCH (root commits + re-pins; I did not commit)
- File: gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/offset-templates/translator-buffer-slot-templates.patch, sha256 a0fbaac5...
- Base: 68dffde. Additive only: crates/metal2vulkan/src/bind/plan.rs and bind/mod.rs.
  - pub struct BufferSlotTemplate {slot, window, descriptor, alignment, max_range, disjoint, written}
  - BindingPlan::buffer_slot_templates()
  - BufferSlotTemplate::descriptor_range(bind_offset, length): a wrapper over the crate's own descriptor_range rule.
- rustfmt --check is clean.
- Apply with git apply in BOTH references/metal2vulkan-tegu-pin and gpu/build/metal2vulkan. Commit, then bump PIN in gpu/metal/tegu/build_air_bridge.py.
- The iOS libtegu_air_bridge.a must be rebuilt from the new pin. Today's archive lacks the new export; the bundle strict link would fail with 'undefined symbol tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_buffer_templates'.

FRONTEND PATCH
- File: gpu/build/compile-stall-20261026/offset-templates/frontend-offset-templates-c6p.patch, sha256 d94fcbfb...
- Applies cleanly (patch -p1 dry-run from work/) to the frozen C6p tree.
- Files: render_pipeline.inc, render_encoder.inc (PLANMISS tmpl counters), air_bridge.rs/.h (new export tegu_air_render_pipeline_plan_generic_buffer_templates), tools/frame_bench_main.m (FB_OFFSET_RING).

PRIVATE VALIDATION
Private translator copy + private cdylib + private gpu tree, on the frozen sources plus this patch.
- cargo build OK; cargo test 34/34.
- iOS -Werror syntax check rc=0.
- CA host test PASS with TEGU_PLAN_MEMO_VERIFY on: every memo hit is re-planned in full and byte-compared; 0 mismatches.
- Render harness rc=0 (32 baseline). Async frontend 6/6.
- frame_bench with VERIFY on, all ok, 0 mismatches:

  | run | hits | misses | templates made | refused | template hits |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | FB_OFFSET_RING=0 | 4304 | 6 | 0 | - | - |
  | FB_OFFSET_RING=1 | 4301 | 9 | 3 | 0 | 3256 |
  | FB_OFFSET_RING=2 | 4301 | 9 | 3 | 0 | 3256 |

  RING=2 also varies offset bits 2-3.

- Timing, RING=1, VERIFY off, steady frames, templates on vs NORD2_METAL_PLAN_TEMPLATES=0:

  | scenario | plan_us | encode CPU us |
  |---|---|---|
  | ca200 | 1264 -> 106 | 1796 -> 530 (-70%) |
  | large | 692 -> 63 | 960 -> 281 |
  | medium | 304 -> 26 | 429 -> 122 |
  | blur_heavy | 101 -> 25 | 233 -> 156 |

  Misses without templates: 5895 of 7750 lookups. With templates: 9.
- Device context: c6m spent plan_ms 9419 of draw_ms 19482, and 93% of misses were offset-only.

Not yet run: run_host_tests and the integration test. They run in the shared tree after C6p is committed, then I post STABLE.
